business_summary: KUWAZAWA Holdings Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides construction materials and works in Japan. The company sells basic materials, including cement, ready-mixed concretes, civil engineering materials, and steel products; building materials, such as interior and exterior materials; housing equipment, such as kitchens and unit bathrooms; lumber, plywood, and structural materials; and private-label products. It also provides construction services, such as interior finishing, exterior wall, waterproofing, tile, and glass sash works, as well as steel bridge, scaffolding, and water supply and drainage equipment construction; and designs and constructs custom-built houses and new condominiums, renovation and repair work, and sale of real estate. In addition, the company offers transportation services comprising construction materials delivery, automobile and crane leasing and rental, civil engineering work, warehousing, and logistics; produces and sells ready-mixed and precast concrete products; and processes and sells sashes, assembly work, and glass panels and door installation. Further, it is involved in personal and corporate insurance agency businesses; automobile maintenance and repair; various support services; vehicle pickup arrangements; facility management; and collection, transportation, and processing of waste. The company was formerly known as KUWAZAWA Trading Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to KUWAZAWA Holdings Corporation in October 2020. KUWAZAWA Holdings Corporation was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: KUWAZAWA Holdings Corporation은 자회사와 함께 일본에서 건축 자재 및 공사를 제공합니다. 시멘트, 레미콘, 토목자재, 철강제품 등 기초자재를 판매하는 회사입니다. 내외장재 등의 건축자재; 주방, 유닛욕실 등의 주택설비; 목재, 합판, 구조재; 그리고 개인 상표 제품. 또한 내부 마감, 외벽, 방수, 타일, 유리 샷시 작업은 물론 철교, 비계, 상하수도 장비 건설 등의 건설 서비스도 제공합니다. 맞춤형 주택과 새 콘도미니엄을 설계 및 건설하고, 개조 및 수리 작업, 부동산 판매를 담당합니다. 또한 이 회사는 건축 자재 배송, 자동차 및 크레인 임대 및 토목 공사, 창고 보관, 물류 등의 운송 서비스를 제공합니다. 레미콘 및 프리캐스트 콘크리트 제품을 생산 및 판매합니다. 샤시, 조립작업, 유리패널, 도어설치 등을 가공, 판매하고 있습니다. 또한 개인 및 기업 보험 대리점 사업에도 참여하고 있습니다. 자동차
